name: Counter
description: Counts what arrives and sends the running count. Max's counter.
vue:
<template>
  <v-card :width="width" density="compact">
    <v-card-title class="text-body-2 py-1"><v-icon size="small" class="mr-1">mdi-counter</v-icon>Counter</v-card-title>
    <v-card-text class="py-1 text-h6">{{ count }}</v-card-text>
  </v-card>
</template>
<script>
export default {
  props: { node: Object, state: Object },
  data() { return { width: 170 }; },
  computed: { count() { const d = this.node && this.node.data; return (d && d.count) || 0; } },
};
</script>
